prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, hint] adoption_photo_troubleshooting_tips: Displays helpful tips on photo quality and lighting directly on the upload photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use bright lighting and a clear front view of your pet for best results."}}
1: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_account_persistence_warning: Updates the sign-in screen headline and body to remind users to sign in with their existing account to avoid losing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign in to keep your pets safe", "body": "Use your original email or sign-in method so your pets and progress remain intact."}}
2: [home, new_screen] waiting_interactive_activity_screen: Adds a dedicated interactive activity screen during pet generation so users have engaging content while waiting.
   config: {"new_wait_activities": {"headline": "Preparing your pet...", "body": "While your companion is being crafted, check out these fun ways to interact with your pet!"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_wait_activities", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, layout] home_intro_interaction_overview: Changes the home intro layout to a split screen highlighting fundamental pet controls and navigation.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "body": "Click your pet to interact, drag across your screen to move, or right-click for desktop options."}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_story_scroll_redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a story scroll layout showing path options seamlessly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose how you want to meet your desktop pet"}}
5: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_carousel_redesign: Redesigns the friend selection step into an interactive carousel layout for browsing pet choices.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Browse available companions"}}
6: [choose_path, new_screen] new_welcome_overview_screen: Adds a new welcome orientation screen right before story setup to guide first-time users.
   config: {"new_welcome_overview": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Let's set up your personal desktop companion in just a few quick steps!"}, "_order": ["new_welcome_overview", "story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [home, new_flow] waiting_status_notification_flow: Enables desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
8: [finish, new_screen] finish_desktop_display_troubleshooter_screen: Adds a final screen offering visibility check instructions if the pet fails to render on the desktop.
   config: {"new_desktop_troubleshooter": {"headline": "Checking desktop visibility", "body": "If your pet isn't visible on screen yet, check your system tray icon or display overlay permissions."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_troubleshooter"]}
9: [choose_path, wait_info] choose_path_time_estimate: Displays a time estimate indicator on the choose_path screen to reassure users about onboarding duration.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Takes less than 2 minutes to complete"}}

verdicts.reason: Adds photo upload tips to the upload screen without violating onboarding rules.
Updates sign-in copy to remind users about account persistence without altering functionality.
Adds an interactive wait activity screen within onboarding while retaining all required steps.
Redesigns the home intro screen layout within allowed onboarding modifications.
Redesigns the path selection screen layout while preserving its core functionality.
Redesigns friend selection into a carousel layout without removing required jobs.
Adds a new welcome orientation screen to onboarding while retaining all required steps.
Enables notification options during the waiting screen, which is allowed under rule 4.
Adds a troubleshooting screen after home intro, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Displays a reasonable time estimate indicator without creating false urgency or violating rules.
